intent.outcome: Taps panel uses one brew tap-info --json call to populate all tap rows; FormulaNames and CaskNames are fetched lazily on tap detail open.

problem.description: Bkp M27 marked Planned; not implemented in wip. Currently taps panel likely makes one call per tap, causing slow load with many taps.

acceptance_criteria.description: Taps panel uses a single tap-info --json call regardless of tap count.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: go test -run TestTapsBatchLoad ./internal/brew/... shows 1 call recorded

acceptance_criteria.description: FormulaNames/CaskNames are fetched lazily on tap detail.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: go test -run TestTapsLazyDetail ./internal/brew/... shows 0 calls before detail open
